status.en: 11 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 21% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 11 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 21 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraqi courts have sentenced seven French citizens to lengthy prison terms for Islamic State membership, including six life sentences, while security forces have repeatedly intercepted unidentified drones over Baghdad, with at least one downed by air defenses. Yazidi militia units linked to the PKK are disarming and joining the Iraqi army, and other militia groups have pledged to disarm by mid-2027. Baghdad is engaged in ongoing talks with the Gulf states and Iran on a regional security plan, and the Iraqi prime minister is meeting Jordanian officials to boost trade and energy cooperation. The conflict produced 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske domstoler har dømt syv franske borgere til lange fengselsstraffer for medlemskap i IS, inkludert seks livstidsdommer, mens sikkerhetsstyrker gjentatte ganger har avskjært uidentifiserte droner over Bagdad, hvor minst én ble skylt ned av luftforsvaret. Yazidi-militære enheter knyttet til PKK blir avrustet og slutter seg til den irakiske hæren, og andre militsgrupper har lovet å avrustes innen midten av 2027. Bagdad er i pågående samtaler med gulfstatene og Iran om en regional sikkerhetsplan, og Iraks statsminister møter jordanske tjenestemenn for å styrke handel og energisamarbeid. Konflikten førte til 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
